info.name: NeevCloud Model API — Automated Tests
info.description:
Functional, negative, and edge-case coverage for the NeevCloud Model API (https://docs.ai.neevcloud.com/ai-inference/overview-1), generated to mirror the OpenAPI spec at https://docs.ai.neevcloud.com/api-reference/model-routing.

Import the companion environment (NeevCloud-Model-API.postman_environment.json), set `api_key`, and run with the Collection Runner or Newman. See README.md for full setup and data-file-driven parametrized runs.
